name: with requireConsent, withdrawing consent drops the buffer and nothing is uploaded while it stays withdrawn, also after a relaunch
source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-security-audit-run2-remediation-design.md D6 (audit run-2 F6) — a withdrawal must stop the identified events already buffered from leaving the device, not only the ones tracked after it. The relaunch case covers a queue persisted by an older SDK before the denial: a persisted denial alone must keep it on the device.
